seo.youtube_title: Seoul's Coolest Neighborhood Nobody Talks About

cuts.scene_description: 성수동 + 서울숲 동시 소개 — 도심 속 두 얼굴을 한 컷에 담은 오프닝
cuts.narration: One neighborhood. Two worlds. Seongsu-dong — Seoul's hippest streets. And right next door, Seoul Forest — nature in the heart of the city.

cuts.narration: Right next door — Seoul Forest. 1.2 million square meters of pure nature, smack in the middle of the city.
